name: sgs/testimonial-slider
title: SGS Testimonial Slider
description: Carousel of testimonials with CSS scroll-snap and optional autoplay.

slider.label: Slider
slider._layer_note: Root IS the carousel wrapper — SGS_Container_Wrapper kind='layout' renders it (render.php:460-471; DB block_composition.container_kind=layout, wraps_block=sgs/container). MF-3 makes the root OUTER, mirroring card-grid/content-collection.
slider._note: css:align-items is an honest gap (no alignItems attr declared — only alignContent/justifyItems). `nameFontSize` was removed 2026-08-06 — no editor control, no consumer anywhere in the repo (D338-cleared). textColourGradient/textColourHoverGradient added 2026-09-04 (D744-pattern text-colour gradient rollout) -- background moved off this same root selector onto a ::after layer (sgs_block_background_layer_css()) so background-clip:text on the text colour cannot clip the background paint, mirroring sgs/info-box's identical text-and-background-on-one-element migration.

arrow.label: Prev/next arrow
arrow._note: showArrows toggles visibility only (render.php:333-341) — no colour/size/style attrs exist per-arrow; styling comes from static style.css theme defaults.

dot.label: Navigation dot
dot._note: showDots toggles visibility only (render.php:343-363) — no colour/size attrs exist per-dot.

track.label: Slide track
track._note: The `.sgs-testimonial-slider__track` scroll strip inside `.stage` (render.php:304,480) — distinct from the `slider` wrapper element above. `slidesVisible` sets the `--sgs-slides-visible` custom property consumed by this element's own CSS (render.php:304). Added 2026-08-15, no manifest element previously covered it. `clusters: []` — slidesVisible is a slide-count control, not a Text/Fill/Layout style value, so it stays an honest by-design orphan rather than being force-mapped to a cluster member that doesn't exist for it.

sgs._ownership_note: OWNERSHIP BOUNDARY (Spec 35): each slide is rendered by iterating $block->inner_blocks and calling $inner_block->render() (render.php:286-301) — a genuine child-block render, not a scalar array. Quote text, author name, role, rating, avatar and card-style all belong ENTIRELY to the child sgs/testimonial block's own manifest and are deliberately NOT declared here — declaring them would cross the delegated-rendering ownership boundary. Only the carousel chrome this block itself emits (slider wrapper, arrows, dots) is declared above.

_selectorsNote: S1 fix (2026-09-02, uniformity sweep, inspector-scan rule 33): selectors.typography retargeted from '.sgs-testimonial-slider__quote' to the block root ('.wp-block-sgs-testimonial-slider'). No element in this block's own rendered markup ever carried the quote class — the quote text belongs to a child sgs/testimonial InnerBlocks (render.php:179-183 already documents this and works around it with a manual PHP-side root-scoped rule).

textColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the slider's text with a background-clip:text mechanism instead of a flat colour (D744-pattern rollout). Non-empty wins over textColour.

borderColourHoverGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the hover-state slider border with a masked ::before ring instead of a flat colour (D636 border-gradient rollout). Non-empty wins over borderColourHover on hover.

borderColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the border with a masked ring instead of a flat colour (D636 border-gradient rollout). Non-empty wins over borderColour.
